build_retinanet_model: build a RetinaNet object detection model config using Detectron2 LazyCall with ResNet-50 FPN backbone
create_retinanet_head: create a RetinaNetHead config with 4 conv layers of 256 channels and 9 anchors per location
configure_anchor_generator: configure a DefaultAnchorGenerator with 5 scales and 3 aspect ratios across 5 FPN levels
setup_fpn_backbone: setup an FPN backbone with ResNet-50 bottom-up and LastLevelP6P7 top block for feature pyramids
configure_anchor_matcher: configure a Matcher with 0.4 and 0.5 IoU thresholds for positive and negative anchor matching
